claim: REAL BUG, TOP/LEFT-SIGNED, SECOND ORDER. The GTAO march computed its sample pixel as `px + int(off + 0.5f)`, and C truncation toward zero makes that round-half-up ONLY for off >= -0.5; every negative offset lands ONE PIXEL SHORT. It does not average out over the rotations, because buildSliceTrig builds phi = (s + jit)*(PI/slices) with jit in [0,1], so phi never leaves [0,PI) and sin(phi) - the y component of every slice direction at all 16 rotations - is non-negative: every UP-going sample landed 1 px low and every LEFT-going sample 1 px right, while down/right were exact. Fixed by rounding to nearest (--ssao_gtao_round_fix, default ON, one instruction CHEAPER). Delta at cam A: rms 0.0044 AO, max 0.0908, 3.39 % of px move >0.01; asymmetric in the predicted direction - top 256-px band mean -0.00185 (6.82 % of px >0.01) vs bottom +0.00186 (1.12 %), left -0.00140 (4.24 %) vs right -0.00068 (0.03 %).

claim: BOTH OF HIS ARTIFACTS ARE ONE ROOT CAUSE, AND IT IS NOT A DEPTH-DISCONTINUITY BUG. Traced at t=5726 px(1129,225): the black saw-tooth column is NOT the near wall occluding the far background - those samples are correctly rejected (OUT-OF-RANGE, |d| = 31.5 against a 4 u radius). The black pixels are ON THE NEAR WALL, grazing, just inside its own silhouette, occluding THEMSELVES. Two guards were missing because the uniform ladder put the first sample 48-192 px out and never needed them. (a) THICKNESS: the bitmask back face is d - V*thickness, a flat world constant, so when |d| is much smaller than thickness it lands BEHIND the receiver and acos(dot(b,V)) saturates at PI - in the trace one sample at |d| = 0.066 set 11 of 32 sectors and one at 0.285 set THIRTY, and the saturation vanishes at the first step whose |d| (1.274) exceeds thickness (1.0). Fixed by --ssao_gtao_thick_clamp: back face bounded by min(thickness,|d|). (b) SELF-OCCLUSION: --ssao_bias is read ONLY by the hemisphere sampler, so GTAO shipped with no bias at all; at ~5 px the ZPage16 quantum (0.0025 u) and the half-res cell offset become a horizon at grazing incidence. Fixed by --ssao_gtao_bias (plane distance, AUTO 0.05 u). RESULTS at 1512x848 on his exact arm: t=5726 column fully-black fraction 32.90 % -> 0.03 % (std 0.343 -> 0.216); t=5836 column 8.23 % -> 0.00 % (std 0.280 -> 0.148, the shipped uniform arm is 0.147); t=5836 near-wall banding std 0.1462 -> 0.0725, BELOW the shipped uniform arm's 0.0796. Isolation: bias alone leaves 11.58 %/1.36 % black (the clamp owns the columns), clamp alone leaves the banding at std 0.139 (the bias owns the banding). --ssao_downscale=1 changes neither (37.59 %/9.86 % black), so the bilateral upsample is NOT implicated - that hypothesis is refuted.
